item.title: How tithes and offerings became an ₦8 trillion use case on Moniepoint
item.description: The data shows that religious giving is increasingly processed through fintech infrastructure, and Moniepoint has effectively become a conduit for one of Nigeria’s largest, least-examined financial flows.

item.title: African startups have a number problem
